stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: In the 5-minute window, span-status counts for checkout show oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR at an increase of 3.75 (and STATUS_CODE_UNSET at 1.25) in the same window.

checkout's server-side PlaceOrder RPC shows both rpc_grpc_status_code 0 (1.25) and rpc_grpc_status_code 13 INTERNAL (1.25) in the window, so a portion of PlaceOrder responses are gRPC INTERNAL errors.

payment emits its own ERROR-status spans on grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge with increase 3.75 in the window, the same magnitude as checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge ERROR (3.75), identifying payment's Charge handler as the failing element.

payment's error spans carry the exact message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' with exception.stacktrace at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37), service payment, service_version 2.0.2 — e.g. trace 7af3340723090525269dc4cb58d619f0 span e0c5a50cee7855aa (13594 us), trace 6b6a8ff430c2f991dde5c084f993fe3c span 03e1b819545c37db (3861 us), trace 3660db9eb18988373fd0834c83b04892 span 17d39a31c106cf68 (1364 us).

checkout's PlaceOrder error spans carry status description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' with rpc.grpc.status_code 13, e.g. trace 6b6a8ff430c2f991dde5c084f993fe3c span b867b8524efea3f0 and trace 7af3340723090525269dc4cb58d619f0 span 0d27d336d5eb50e3.

checkout's client RPC to payment returns a mixture of grpc status codes in the window: Charge rpc_grpc_status_code 0 = 3.75 and rpc_grpc_status_code 2 (UNKNOWN) = 1.25; the same query shows checkout's other dependencies (CurrencyService Convert, CartService GetCart/EmptyCart, ProductCatalogService GetProduct, ShippingService GetQuote/ShipOrder) only with rpc_grpc_status_code 0, plus CartService EmptyCart grpc 9 at 0.
